def print_sheet():
    s = SONG
    print("=" * 60)
    print(s["title"].upper())
    print(s["artist"], "|", s["bpm"], "BPM", "|", s["time"], "| Key:", s["song_key"])
    print("=" * 60)
    for sec in s["structure"]:
        print("\n[" + sec.upper() + "]   (" + s["chords"].get(sec, "") + ")")
        for line in s["lyrics"].get(sec, "").split("\n"):
            if line.strip():
                print("  " + line)
    print("\n--- arrangement ---\n" + s["arrangement"])

def write_midi(path="song.mid", bars_per_chord=1):
    # Minimal SMF writer: one track, chord stabs on each bar, melody-ish bass.
    tick = 480
    events = []
    t = 0
    beat = tick
    for sec in SONG["structure"]:
        for sym in SONG["chords"].get(sec, "C").split("-"):
            tones, _ = parse_chord(sym)
            for tone in tones:
                note = 60 + tone
                events.append((t, 0x90, note, 90))
                events.append((t + beat * 4 * bars_per_chord, 0x80, note, 0))
            t += beat * 4 * bars_per_chord
    events.sort()
    track = b"\x00\xff\x03\x0b" + SONG["title"][:11].encode() + b""
    track = b"\x00\xff\x51\x03" + struct.pack(">I", int(60000000 // SONG["bpm"]))[1:]
    last = 0
    body = b""
    def varlen(v):
        out = bytes([v & 0x7F]); v >>= 7
        while v:
            out = bytes([(v & 0x7F) | 0x80]) + out; v >>= 7
        return out
    for (tt, st, n1, n2) in events:
        body += varlen(tt - last) + bytes([st, n1, n2]); last = tt
    body += b"\x00\xff\x2f\x00"
    track = b"MTrk" + struct.pack(">I", len(body)) + body
    head = b"MThd" + struct.pack(">I", 6) + struct.pack(">HHH", 0, 1, tick)
    open(path, "wb").write(head + track)
    print("wrote", path, "-", len(events) // 2, "notes")
